front: What was the Royal Charter of 1889?
back: The grant from the British Crown that gave the British South Africa Company the right to administer and develop the territory north of the Limpopo.

front: When was the Rudd Concession signed?
What was Lobengula promised under the Rudd Concession?
back: £100 a month, 1,000 rifles with 100,000 rounds and a gunboat on the Zambezi (or £500 instead).

front: When was the Royal Charter granted?
When was the flag hoisted at Fort Salisbury?

back: Hopes of gold, Rhodes's ambitions, rivalry with Portugal, the Transvaal and Germany, and the wish for land.

front: Why was the Rudd Concession disputed?
back: Lobengula said that he had been told only a few men would dig and that the written text gave more than he understood.

front: Who was Chaminuka, in Shona tradition?
back: A Zezuru spirit medium remembered as foretelling the coming of the whites.
